author: National Geographic
description:
Wide sandy beaches like El Sardinero have long drawn Spaniards to Santander, but the rest of the world has generally overlooked the Cantabrian capital as a vacation destination. A new cultural renaissance looks set to change that, however, with the opening of two world-class art galleries and the arrival of thousands of artifacts to the Museum of Prehistory and Archaeology, offering more reasons to visit this easygoing beachfront city.
